name: Anti - Dandruff Pro Kit
subtitle: 2-step system for deeper Dandruff control
metaDescription: Experience Dandruff-free hair with our Advanced Scalp Care Kit. Powerful formula for effective Dandruff control.

ingredients.name: ZPTO
ingredients.shortDesc: Clinically proven anti-dandruff active, tackles flakes and itch.
ingredients.longDesc: ZPTO works by breaking down the cell walls of dandruff-causing fungi (like Malassezia). It releases zinc ions that disrupt the fungi’s energy production, stopping their growth and helping reduce dandruff.

ingredients.name: Salicylic Acid
ingredients.shortDesc: Exfoliates build-up, clears scalp for better absorption of actives.
ingredients.longDesc: Salicylic Acid gently exfoliates the scalp by removing dead skin cells and unclogging pores. This helps reduce buildup and allows antifungal ingredients to work more effectively.

ingredients.name: Piroctone Olamine
ingredients.shortDesc: Clinically proven to remove dandruff by targeting fungus (Malassezia) and reducing itch & flaking.
ingredients.longDesc: Piroctone Olamine stops dandruff-causing fungi from growing by cutting off their iron supply. It also helps calm scalp irritation and reduce inflammation.

ingredients.name: Glycerin
ingredients.longDesc: Glycerin attracts and locks in moisture, keeping the scalp hydrated and helping restore its natural barrier.

ingredients.name: Pentavitin
ingredients.longDesc: Pentavitin binds to keratin to create a lasting moisture layer that stays even after rinsing. It provides long-term hydration and helps reduce flaking.

ingredients.name: Medical Grade Silicone
ingredients.shortDesc: Bristles made out of Medical Grade Silicone are gentle on the scalp and deep cleanse your hair without any harm
ingredients.longDesc: Bristles made out of Medical Grade Silicone are gentle on the scalp and deep cleanse your hair without any harm. They are also resistant to bacterial buildup. Best part? These bristles are very durable!.

ingredients.name: Ergonomic Design
ingredients.shortDesc: We've made this brush with a comfortable handle so that it's easy to use and hold
ingredients.longDesc: We've made this brush with a comfortable handle so that it's easy to use and hold. The ergonomic design makes it the perfect accessory to elevate every bath.

howToUse: Step 1: Apply shampoo evenly on wet hair and scalp.Step 2: Use the scalp massager in circular motions for 2-3 minutes.Step 3: Rinse thoroughly.Storage Tip: Rinse and air dry the massager after use.

faqs.question: Will this shampoo completely cure dandruff?
faqs.answer: No shampoo can permanently cure dandruff, but ZPTO + Piroctone Olamine significantly reduce flakes and control recurrence with regular use.

faqs.question: Does it dry out the scalp?
faqs.answer: No, it contains Glycerin, Panthenol, and Allantoin to keep scalp moisturized.

faqs.question: How long before I see results?
faqs.answer: Visible reduction in flakes may be seen in 1 week of consistent use.

faqs.question: Can I use it daily?
faqs.answer: Yes, this shampoo can be used daily. For severe dandruff, please check with you dermatologist.

reviews.author: Prem
reviews.title: Worth the Upgrade
reviews.body: I used the regular Anti-Dandruff Shampoo earlier, but this kit gives even better results. The scalp feels cleaner, and the massager makes every wash more effective.

reviews.author: Manish Shetty
reviews.title: Feels Like a Salon Scalp Treatment
reviews.body: The combination of the shampoo and the massager gives a refreshing deep-clean feeling. It feels therapeutic and effective.

reviews.author: Rahul K
reviews.title: No More Flakes on My Black T-Shirt
reviews.body: In just one week, the flakes are almost gone. I can wear dark clothes without worrying now. Really impressed with how gentle yet effective this is.

reviews.author: Jay Kapoor
reviews.title: The Scalp Massager Is a Game Changer
reviews.body: Never thought a tool could improve results this much. The shampoo cleans deeply, and the massager helps spread it evenly. My scalp feels cleaner and lighter.

reviews.title: Flake-Free and Fresh
reviews.body: Noticed less itching and fewer flakes. My scalp feels more balanced, neither dry nor greasy. Love the 2-step routine approach.
